summary: Medirom Healthcare Technologies Inc. filed a Form 6-K disclosing receipt of a Nasdaq deficiency notice for failure to timely file its Form 20-F for FY2025, risking delisting. The company has 60 days (until July 27, 2026) to submit a compliance plan; Nasdaq may grant up to 180 days (to November 11, 2026) to regain compliance by filing the overdue 20-F. If the plan is rejected, an appeal to a Hearings Panel is available. This is a non-US filer (Japan) reporting a NASDAQ listing standard violation. Watch for the company's ability to file its 20-F within the grace period to avoid suspension/delisting.
